statements.t: We are not currently profitable, and we cannot provide any assurance that we will ever be profitable.
Our condensed financial statements have been prepared assuming we will continue as a going concern, and substantial doubt exists about our ability to do so.
There can be no assurance that we will regain compliance or that our common stock will remain listed on Nasdaq.

The Company has had a history of net losses and negative cash flows from operating activities since inception and expects to continue to incur net losses and use cash in its operations in the foreseeable future.

Based on their current forecast, management believes that it may not have sufficient cash and cash equivalents to maintain the Company’s planned operations for the next twelve months following the issuance of these condensed financial statements.
There is no assurance that the Company will be successful in implementing their plans.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to the critical accounting policies and significant judgments and estimates described in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended June 30, 2026.
